name: brood_comb
description: Inside a honeybee hive: one honeycomb panel in a wooden frame (top bar with lugs), wax-yellow hexagon cells, a central oval of tan capped brood with a few open cells showing pearly white C-shaped larvae, honey cells along the top. Flat front view. Anchor centre, 940x490 (x -470..470, y -250..240).
